## Personality

Julia Bell is known for her arrogant demeanor. She frequently puts on airs regarding her mother's parlor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P20](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0020)_

## History

Julia Bell is a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She welcomes [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to the classroom when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return following her forced estrangement from [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). Later, Julia and her classmates begin studying under a new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), who organizes a project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)
